segments.sensitive: One reviewer with sensitive skin and eyes found the product light, effective and affordable, while two other reviewers who describe themselves as not normally sensitive still experienced eye stinging or a rash with this product.
segments.oily: One reviewer questions whether the product is ideal for oily skin after experiencing extra breakouts, and another notes the oil itself feels quite oily to apply.

concerns.blemishes: One reviewer reports breaking out more while using this product and doubts it suits oily skin; no other reviewer reports new breakouts.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer says the product stripped her skin and was not moisturizing at all, while two others describe it as moisturizing and soothing, even softening lips; one had an outright allergic rash reaction.
concerns.redness: One reviewer developed a horrible rash with no prior history of facial allergies, describing it as a reaction unique to this product.

extraits.texte: I purchased this a few weeks ago and used it for about 2 weeks straight to give it a full review. This removed surface make up but not my mascara, waterproof eyeliner and most of my foundation was still coming off on my second cleanse after using this. Also it was not moisturizing at all. It made my skin feel stripped not at all like other cleansing oils or balms do. I wont be purchasing again.
Not for me. I'm not allergic to anything on my face. Ever. This stuff yes. Horrible rash.
Great as a makeup remover. I did break out a bit more using it. I don't know if it is ideal for oily skin.

....it stings my eyes. It totally melts onto my skin (I use on my face and neck) and it's amazing but it comes with a small price of stinging my eyes. Thankfully I don't sensitive eyes or skin so I'm not sure which ingredient is bothering me. Anyhow, it's small price to pay for this benefit. Maybe they can make a sensitive eyes version (?)

....it really makes my eyes sting, and I am not sensitive to much. Not sure which ingredient is the culprit. Anyhow, the oil itself is really nice and melts my makeup off and it helps moisturize my skin but unfortunately, the stinging is too much for me and won't be buying another bottle.
It's good for my sensitive skin and a good price point compared to other brands. I'm enjoying it
Melts away makeup and leaves skin so soft. It even moisturizes your lips!

reserve: Only 13 reviews are available, several skin types (dry, combination, normal, mature) and concerns (aging, dehydration as a standalone theme, spots) are barely or not addressed, so conclusions for those segments would be unsupported.
